author: Kai Lentit
description:
Next-door 10x engineer, part 4: burning Claude tokens on the HP printer and running AGI out of the bedroom.

AI-obsessed engineers. In this episode our garage-dwelling 10x engineer explains why a microwave needs an async engine, swaps his mattress for an Nvidia GPU cluster, keeps a memory leak parked on S3 and waits for the free usage reset. He also guards his NixOS config like a state secret and warns you about the Claude Basilisk.

If you write code, use Claude or other AI tools, or live on software engineer memes, you will know this guy.

#humor #jokes #ai
title: *Next-door 10x Engineer* (pt.4)
